title: Towards Reliable Medical LLMs: Benchmarking and Enhancing Confidence Estimation of Large Language Models in Medical Consultation
authors: Zhiyao Ren; Yibing Zhan; Siyuan Liang; Guozheng Ma; Baosheng Yu; Dacheng Tao
why_relevant: Proposes a confidence estimation benchmark and method (MedConf) that uses RAG to ground confidence in supporting/missing/contradictory evidence relations, touching on calibration and evidence sufficiency.
